title.en: Send ERC-20 tokens from the Safe
title.zh-TW: 從 Safe 轉出 ERC-20 代幣

summary.en: The Safe calls `transfer` directly on the token contract you pick, sending the amount you type to the recipient you pick. There is only one call. It goes through no router or other contract, and leaves no allowance.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 直接呼叫你選的代幣合約的 `transfer`，把你填的金額轉給你選的收款人。只有一個呼叫，不經過任何路由或其他合約，也不留下授權。

text.en: A plain token transfer: the Safe calls transfer on the token contract directly and leaves no allowance.
text.zh-TW: 單純的代幣轉帳：Safe 直接呼叫代幣合約的 transfer，不留下授權。

text.en: The page is on etherfi.gitbook.io, not ether.fi, the site DefiLlama lists. CoinGecko's ether-fi coin links its whitepaper on etherfi.gitbook.io, and the page lists weETH as 0xCd5fE23C85820F7B72D0926FC9b05b43E359b7ee, the address CoinGecko lists for Wrapped eETH.
text.zh-TW: 頁面在 etherfi.gitbook.io，不是 DefiLlama 列的 ether.fi。CoinGecko 的 ether-fi 幣把白皮書連到 etherfi.gitbook.io，頁面上的 weETH 是 0xCd5fE23C85820F7B72D0926FC9b05b43E359b7ee，跟 CoinGecko 列的 Wrapped eETH 地址一樣。

recommendation.en: Acceptable: CoinGecko lists the same address.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受：CoinGecko 列的是同一個地址。

role.en: A token you can pick: USDC, issued by Circle
role.zh-TW: 可選的代幣：Circle 發行的 USDC

role.en: A token you can pick: USDT, issued by Tether
role.zh-TW: 可選的代幣：Tether 發行的 USDT

role.en: A token you can pick: Morpho's governance token
role.zh-TW: 可選的代幣：Morpho 的治理代幣

role.en: A token you can pick: cbBTC, issued by Coinbase
role.zh-TW: 可選的代幣：Coinbase 發行的 cbBTC

1.transfer.value.en: The amount sent, in the token's base units. card new lets you type whole tokens and converts them with the token's `decimals`, read on chain.
1.transfer.value.zh-TW: 轉出的數量，以代幣的最小單位計；card new 讓你填整顆代幣，再用鏈上的 `decimals` 換算。
